text.description_html:
DEXTER ED2000-SP28 Touch Bar Rim Exit Device

DEXTER ED2000-SP28 touch bar style panic exit devices are suitable for all hollow metal, or wood doors where there is no projection on the door face. UL listed PANIC HARDWARE, durable enough for the most demanding applications.

These exit devices are non-handed and for doors 29" - 36" wide. The latch and springs are made from long lasting high strength stainless steel.

Features and Specifications:

  • Material: Durable, steel mechanism case construction.
  • Latch: Stainless Steel, 3/4" throw - 5/8" deadlatch
  • Strike: Surface mounted for 5/8" stop with shim
  • Projection: 2-1/2" - 1-7/8" dogged
  • Stile: 3-1/2" minimum
  • Handing: Reversible, non-handed
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" standard
  • Door Width: 36", can be field sized to 29"
  • Mounting Height: Recommended installation at 41" from finished floor to center line of push rail
  • Dogging: 1/2" of a turn 7/32" hex key
  • UL Listed: SA33091 51X4
  • Grade 2
  • Finish: Aluminum



** Item Discontinued. See available Panic Bars
